issues.detail: '[save returned false]' starts on its group's first lifeline (PlantUML usually draws it there); keep it short, or start the group at a participant further left

5 of 12 messages cross the lifelines between their participants (AuthenticationController + RestExceptionHandler HTTP in, exception to status - UserManager validate, check unique, choose factory, persist: 3 message(s) over 1 lifeline(s), UserManager validate, check unique, choose factory, persist - UserRegistry lookups and save of users: 2 message(s) over 1 lifeline(s)); reorder participants so most messages go between neighbours
